Text:
All Divisions except Ambala (04 BOs) and Rohtak have authrorized BOs and completed training for International Mail Booking.

Further, proposals for weiging scale procurement have been recieved from Ambala, Faridabad, Hisar and Kurukshetra.
BO visit plan has been shared by all the Divisions.

All divisional heads informed that they have reached out to local social media influencers and formulated strategies for increasing social media reach.

Exclusive person for social media in Division Office have been identified except Bhiwani and Gurgaon Division.
All divisional heads informed that Marketing executives have been identified as per the instructions and further specific verticals have been allotted to them.

AD(Estt) informed that proposals were received from all the divisions but observations were made during review of such proposals. All such proposals have been sent back for correction. Further, proposals received from Rohtak Division were found correct. Further instructions are being forwarded to Rohtak Division regarding the proposals received.
All divisional heads have informed that they have further issued the instructions to the field units regarding the new target of achieving Atamnirbhar BO status.
